column3: NASB renders “servant” as “bond-servant,” “according to” as “for,” and “the elect of God” as “those chosen of God.”
NASB renders “before eternal times” as “long ages ago” and reorders the verse.
NASB renders “in His own seasons” as “at the proper time” and “revealed” as “manifested,” and adds “even.”
NASB follows the critical text without “mercy” and “Lord”; “according to” is rendered “in.” A full-width colon appears in the NASB text.
NASB follows the critical text (“I left”); “the things lacking” is rendered “what remains,” and “town” is “city.”
NASB adds “namely” and renders “debauchery” as “dissipation” and “insubordinate” as “rebellion.”
NASB renders “striker” as “pugnacious” and “greedy of base gain” as “fond of sordid gain.”
NASB renders “a lover of good” as “loving what is good,” “self-controlled” as “sensible,” “upright” as “just,” “holy” as “devout,” and “disciplined” as “self-controlled.”
NASB reorders the verse; “encourage” is rendered “exhort,” and “convict” is “refute.”
NASB follows the critical text; it renders “insubordinate” as “rebellious” and has no “also.”
NASB renders “overthrow whole households” as “are upsetting whole families.”
NASB puts the saying in quotation marks and renders “lazy gluttons” as “lazy gluttons.”
NASB follows the critical text without “indeed.”
